basic_info.description: Sophisticated mid-century architecture, streamlined contemporary interiors, glorious natural light, and a prime location affording picturesque views combine in this chic four-bedroom residence on Marina Boulevard. The home enjoys sweeping views that range from the boats of the marina and the St. Francis Yacht Club to a magnificent full sweep of the bay, from Alcatraz and Angel Island to the Marin Headlands and the Golden Gate Bridge. At garden level are a landscaped entryway, an office or bedroom, a full bath, a spacious family room with direct access out to the garden, and a two-car garage. One level above are the welcoming open-plan living and entertaining spaces, which feature the stunning views, a discreet powder room, and a chef's kitchen with a sunny breakfast area. Light floods in thanks to numerous windows and sliding glass doors that give way to a private central terrace. The principal suite is a peaceful oasis with terrace access and a skylit bath with a dual-sink walnut vanity, a walk-in shower, and a soaking tub. The elegant curving stairway rises to the uppermost floor that hosts an impressive lounge with a preeminent postcard-worthy view enjoyed via a wall of windows. Two bedrooms, one with a similarly enviable view, and a shared bath complete the uppermost level.
